2027-01-27.title: Wednesday of the Third Week in Ordinary Time
readings: By a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are sanctified
You are a priest for ever, in the line of Melchizedek
A sower went out to sow
2027-01-27.alt: Weekday of Ordinary Time, Week 3 (Year I). Liturgical colour: green. Optional memorial of St Angela Merici, virgin (white).
2027-01-27.verse: And these are the ones sown on the good soil: they hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirty and sixty and a hundredfold.”
theo: Hebrews contrasts the priests of the old covenant, who stand “day after day… offering again and again the same sacrifices that can never take away sins”, with Christ, who “offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins” and then “sat down at the right hand of God”. The priest who sits has finished his work. “By a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are sanctified.” And God's promise through Jeremiah is fulfilled: “I will remember their sins and their lawless deeds no more.” The Mass does not repeat this sacrifice; it makes the one sacrifice present.

In the Gospel Jesus teaches from a boat, and the first great parable is the sower. Seed falls on the path, on rock, among thorns and on good soil. Jesus explains: Satan takes the word away; trouble makes the shallow fall away; “the cares of the world, and the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word”. But those on good soil “hear the word and accept it and bear fruit”. St Angela Merici, founder of the Ursulines, gave her life to teaching girls the faith, sowing the word in young hearts. Our task is to be good soil and good sowers.
outline: Ask: what crowds out God's word in your day?
Point 1 · The priest who sat down
“They hear the word and accept it and bear fruit.”
live: Identify one worry or desire that chokes God's word, and cut it back.
Share a verse of Scripture with a young person, as St Angela did.
2027-01-27.prayer: Lord Jesus, by your single offering you have perfected those who are sanctified. Make our hearts good soil for your word, free from the thorns of worry and wealth, and through the prayers of St Angela Merici make us sowers of your word for the young. Amen.
altar: At Mass the one sacrifice of Christ is made present; we do not add to it, we enter into it.

quick: Christ's single sacrifice perfects us for all time.
The sower's seed falls on four soils.
Good soil hears, accepts and bears fruit.
2027-01-27.action: Cut back one worry or desire that chokes God's word.
2027-01-27.question: What kind of soil is my heart today?

family.explain: A farmer threw seeds. Birds ate some, some fell on rocks, some in thorns, and some in good soil and grew big. Let our hearts be good soil!
family.intention: We pray for teachers and catechists, through St Angela Merici.
family.ask: Ask: “What can help God's word grow in our family?”

illus: A coconut farmer in Alappuzha explained the parable to his grandson by showing him two seedlings: one planted in cleared soil, the other where weeds had been left. The second was stunted. He said: God's word is like that. If you do not clear the weeds of your phone and your worries, it cannot grow.

pm.open: Lord, sow your word in us, and make us good soil. Amen.
share: By a single offering he has perfected for all time (Hebrews 10:14). Do I trust the completeness of Christ's sacrifice?
The cares of the world… choke the word (Mark 4:19). What chokes the word in me?
They hear the word and accept it (Mark 4:20). How do I accept God's word?
interc: For teachers of the young, through St Angela Merici.
For those whose faith has been choked by worries.
For farmers and all who work the soil.
For our group, that we may bear fruit.
pm.close: Father, your Son's sacrifice has made us holy. Let your word bear fruit in us a hundredfold. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Hebrews tells us that the old priests stood day after day, offering again and again the same sacrifices that can never take away sins. But Christ offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins, and sat down at the right hand of God (Hebrews 10:11–12).
A priest who sits has finished his work. By a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are sanctified (Hebrews 10:14). The Mass makes this one sacrifice present for us.

In the Gospel Jesus tells of the sower. Some seed is choked by thorns: the cares of the world, and the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things (Mark 4:19). But on good soil the word bears fruit thirtyfold, sixtyfold and a hundredfold.
St Angela Merici sowed the word in the hearts of young girls. Let us clear our thorns, be good soil, and sow the word for others. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus says our hearts are like soil. When we listen to God's word and do it, it grows like a big plant!

intro: Theme: “They hear the word and accept it and bear fruit.”
Christ's single sacrifice, and the soil of our hearts.

q: The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind, “You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.”
For by a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are sanctified.
points.apply: Attend Mass this week knowing it makes Calvary present.

q: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; be wise enough to desist.
but the cares of the world, and the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it yields nothing.
points.apply: Reduce screen time to make room for Scripture.

q: For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return there until they have watered the earth, making it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater, so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
And these are the ones sown on the good soil: they hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirty and sixty and a hundredfold.”
points.apply: Share one verse with a young person, as St Angela did.

concl: Christ's sacrifice is complete; his word is sown.
Let us be good soil and good sowers.
2027-01-27.resolve: Read the day's Gospel every morning this week.
